spans.s:
रञ्ज् रञ्ज् or रज्, cl. 1. 4. P. A. रजति,
-ते (ep. also रञ्जति), रज्यति, -ते, र-
रञ्ज (3rd pl. ररजतुस् or ररञ्जतुस्), ररञ्जे,
रङ्क्ष्यति, -ते, अराङ्क्षीत्, अरङ्क्त, रज्यात्,
रङ्क्षीष्ट, रङ्क्तुम्, to be dyed or coloured, to
redden, grow red, glow; to dye, tinge, colour; to
be affected or moved, to have the passions or feelings
roused, to be excited; to be pleased or delighted
with (with inst.); to attach one's self to, be attached
or devoted to, (perhaps in this sense connected with
rt. लग्); fall in love with, be enamoured of (usually
with loc.); to go, (in this sense cl. 1. P. according
to Naighaṇṭuka

): Caus. रञ्जयति, -यते,
-यितुम्, to dye, colour, paint, make red, redden,
illuminate; to rejoice, gratify, exhilarate, charm; to
cause to be attached, to conciliate; (according to
Naighaṇṭuka

) = rt. अर्च्, to worship, (also
रजयति); to hunt, (in this sense only रजयति):
Desid. रिरङ्क्षति, -ते: Intens. रारज्यते, रा-
रङ्क्ति, to be greatly affected or excited; to be
intensely attached or devoted; [cf. Gr. ῥέζ-ω, ῥαγ-εύ-ς,
ῥηγ-εύ-ς, ῥεγ-εύ-ς, ῥέγ-ος, ῥέγ-μα, ῥήσσω,
ῥῆγ-ος, λέγ-νον: probably Angl. Sax. ge-regnian,
‘to colour.’]

रञ्जक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. the Caus.), = रञ्जन,
colouring, dyeing; causing affection or passion, ex-
citing love or pleasure, gladdening, rejoicing, pleas-
ing; (अस्), m. a colourist, dyer, painter; an inciter
of affection &c., stimulus; a species of plant (=
कम्पिल्लक); biliary humor on which vision de-
pends; (अकी), f. a female colourer or dyer; (अम्),
n. red sandal; vermilion.

रञ्जन, अस्, ई, अम्, colouring, dyeing, (केश-
रञ्जन, dyeing the hair); exciting passion or love;
gratifying, exhilarating, delighting, rejoicing, (जन-
रञ्जनी, ‘men-rejoicing,’ N. of a particular formula);
conciliating, befriending; (अस्), m. Saccharum Munja,
= मुञ्ज; (ई), f. the female personification of a
particular musical mode; (probably) friendly saluta-
tion; N. of various plants, the indigo plant; Nyc-
tanthes Arbor Tristis; saffron; a kind of fragrant
perfume; (अम्), n. the act of colouring, dyeing;
colour, dye; the act of pleasing, delighting, concili-
[]
ating, rejoicing, giving pleasure; nasalizing (in
gram.); red sandal-wood.
—रञ्जन-द्रु, उस्, m. a
kind of tree.
रञ्जनक, अस्, m. a kind of tree.

रञ्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, dyed, coloured, tinted; affected,
moved; highly delighted.

रञ्जिनी, f., N. of various plants, the indigo plant;
Rubia Munjista; [cf. रञ्जनी.]
